ideas.name: Token Unlock Price Decline
ideas.claim: Cryptocurrency token prices decline on average around scheduled unlocks; the study reports a stronger reaction to first unlocks.
ideas.quote: First, I find that, despite being fully anticipated, token unlocks lead to an average price drop of 2.5%.
ideas.mechanism: Scheduled release of restricted token supply and possible insider sales.

rules.timeframe: Daily observations; event study around unlocks
rules.filters: Study defines unlocks as circulating supply increases of at least 5% from the previous day and excludes events within 30 days of token generation or ICO.

ideas.claimed_result: Average price decline of 2.5% around an unlock event; the paper also reports a stronger negative reaction for first unlocks.
